# QueueBuzz — Comprehensive Product & Platform Documentation

This document contains full details on QueueBuzz's virtual waitlist features, platform architecture, pricing structures, support policies, privacy specifications, and legal terms of service.

---

## 1. About QueueBuzz

QueueBuzz is a cloud-based, mobile-friendly virtual queue management platform designed to eliminate physical waiting lines for businesses of all sizes, with a primary focus on physical stores globally.

### Platform Concept
Customers join queues without downloading a mobile app or creating an account. By scanning a QR code or visiting a URL (e.g. `https://queuebuzz.com/q/clinic-abc`), their mobile browser transforms into a live digital ticket. They can wander freely while waiting, viewing their real-time queue position and estimated wait time, while the business hosts call next customers with a single click.

---

## 2. Core Features & Capabilities

### Command Center for Hosts
- **Real-Time Queue Console**: View a list of current guests waiting, their positions, ticket numbers, party sizes, and timestamps.
- **Service Categories**: Route guests to appropriate staff members or departments (e.g., "Consultation" vs. "Diagnostics").
- **Manual Positioning**: Reorder guests manually or insert priority walk-ins.
- **Analytics & History**: Track average wait times, active hours, serving throughput, and guest drop-off/skip rates.

### Frictionless Guest Experience
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: The platform is installable on iOS and Android homescreens.
- **Real-time Status Sync**: Instant updates via WebSockets and SSE.
- **Audio Chimes & Push Alerts**: Audible notifications when a user is called, plus Firebase Cloud Messaging push alerts.
- **Device Haptic Vibration**: Haptic feedback on mobile devices to grab the user's attention in noisy environments.

### Smart Admin Controls
- **Average Service Time**: Calculate and display realistic wait times based on historical queue progress.
- **Geo-Locking**: Enforce location checking (using GPS) so customers can only join the queue if they are within a specific radius of the store (e.g. 50 meters).
- **Party Size Limits**: Cap the number of people that can join under a single ticket.
- **Custom Branding**: Upload store logos, banner images, and set custom color palettes matching store branding.

---

## 3. Subscription & Pricing Tiers

QueueBuzz offers multiple plans tailored for businesses of all sizes, available on a monthly or yearly cycle:

### Free Forever
- **Cost**: $0 USD / ₹0 INR
- **Queues per Month**: 1
- **Max Guests per Queue**: 25
- **History Retention**: 3 days
- **Queue Expiry**: 3 hours
- **Features Included**: Live dashboard, browser alerts, standard QR code.
- **Support**: Community support.

### Pro
- **Cost**:
  - **Global (USD)**: $14.99/month (or $134.99/year)
  - **India (INR)**: ₹899/month (or ₹9,999/year)
- **Queues per Month**: 50
- **Max Guests per Queue**: 500
- **History Retention**: 90 days
- **Queue Expiry**: 72 hours (3 days)
- **Features Included**: History access, view guest data, location check (geo-locking), and data export.
- **Support**: Standard email support.

### Business Elite
- **Cost**:
  - **Global (USD)**: $39.99/month (or $449.99/year)
  - **India (INR)**: ₹2,499/month (or ₹27,999/year)
- **Queues per Month**: 200
- **Max Guests per Queue**: Unlimited
- **History Retention**: Unlimited
- **Queue Expiry**: 168 hours (7 days)
- **Features Included**: Full Custom Branding, history access, view guest data, location check (geo-locking), and data export.
- **Support**: Priority email support.

### Enterprise
- **Cost**: Custom Pricing
- **Queues per Month**: Unlimited
- **Max Guests per Queue**: Unlimited
- **History Retention**: Unlimited
- **Queue Expiry**: 720 hours (30 days)
- **Features Included**: Custom limits, dedicated support, full Custom Branding, history access, view guest data, location check (geo-locking), and data export.
- **Support**: Dedicated support.

---

## 4. Privacy & Data Minimalization

QueueBuzz is designed around privacy-first principles:
- **No Identity Tracking**: Guests join by providing a display name. Phone numbers and emails are optional and only collected if the Host configures SMS or Email notification methods.
- **Ephemeral Sessions**: Customer session cookies are deleted upon leaving the queue or when the queue expires.
- **Data Safety**: We do not sell user data to advertising networks. Business data remains secure and private.

## 6. Condensed Terms of Service

1. **Acceptance of Terms**: Users (Hosts and Guests) agree to these terms when using the platform.
2. **Service Access**: We provide the virtual queuing SaaS "as is". Hosts are responsible for their client interactions, and we do not guarantee uptime under the Free tier.
3. **Usage Limitations**: Under no circumstances should the service be used to coordinate illegal actions. Spamming the platform with artificial entries will lead to account termination.
4. **Subscription Cancellations**: Subscriptions can be canceled at any time from the account settings. No refunds are offered for partial months.
